description: Source code for the ListCurrency class in SuiteCRM, managing currency data including listing, adding, updating, and generating HTML/JavaScript for currency management.

classes.name: ListCurrency
classes.description: Class for managing currency data, including listing, adding, updating, and generating related HTML and JavaScript.

methods.name: lookupCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of currencies and sets the focus to a new currency bean.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Handles adding a new currency if the user is an admin and form data is valid.

methods.name: handleUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating existing currencies based on submitted form data if the user is an admin.

methods.name: getJavascript
methods.description: Returns JavaScript functions for currency conversion and updating UI elements.

methods.name: getSelectOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML options for currency selection and initializes JavaScript variables for conversion rates and symbols.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Generates HTML table for displaying and editing currency data.

methods.name: setCurrencyFields
methods.description: Sets JavaScript variables for currency fields based on provided field names.
